what_this_is: Per method, what has been measured and what has not. 'Complete' means the genuine package ran non-degenerately on the full roster, with calibrated per-sample uncertainty, no degenerate solves, and no open defect bearing on its numbers. A method failing one of these is still reportable WITH the failure disclosed; what is not acceptable is failing one silently.
